# Aurelius Agent

> Aurelius Agent is a Stoic accountability partner for iOS. You write a daily journal entry. It scores Energy, Focus, Physical and Satisfaction, compares what you said you would do with what you did, and gives a weekly Stoic judgment of the patterns you might not see yourself. Made by Sparboe Systems in Norway.

- Platform: iPhone, iOS 16 or newer
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6761541267
- Pricing: $89.99 per year after a 7-day free trial, or $14.99 per month
- Founder: Ulrik Sparboe (https://sparboesystems.com)

## Guides

- [Not All AI Journal Feedback Is Equal: Here's What to Look For](https://aureliusagent.com/guides/ai-journal-feedback-quality/): AI journaling feedback exists on a spectrum from generic affirmation to behavioral accountability. Most apps stay at level 1-2 because honest feedback causes churn. Here's what level 4 looks like.
- [How Much Should an AI Journaling App Cost?](https://aureliusagent.com/guides/ai-journaling-app-pricing/): AI journaling apps range from free (with privacy trade-offs) to $20/month. The real question isn't the price but what you're comparing it to: a notebook, a coach, or a therapist.
- [AI Journaling App That Learns About You Over Time](https://aureliusagent.com/guides/ai-journaling-app-that-learns/): An AI journal that genuinely learns builds a knowledge graph of your patterns, values, and behavioral history. Most apps use stateless API calls. Here's the difference and why it matters.
- [AI Journaling for Men Who Don't Journal](https://aureliusagent.com/guides/ai-journaling-for-men/): Most journaling apps are designed around emotional expression. AI journaling reframes the practice as performance tracking, pattern recognition, and honest accountability: built for men who want results, not therapy.
- [Do AI Journaling Apps Keep Your Data Private? What to Check Before You Write](https://aureliusagent.com/guides/ai-journaling-privacy/): Most AI journaling apps send your entries to OpenAI or Anthropic servers, store them indefinitely, and may use them for training. Here's what to check before trusting an app with your inner life.
- [Is AI Journaling Better Than Regular Journaling?](https://aureliusagent.com/guides/ai-journaling-vs-regular/): Regular journaling is freeform expression with no feedback loop. AI journaling adds pattern recognition, scoring, and accountability. Each has strengths. The question is what you need.
- [AI Life Coach vs Therapist: A Decision Framework](https://aureliusagent.com/guides/ai-life-coach-vs-therapist/): AI coaching handles daily accountability, pattern recognition, and goal tracking. Therapy handles trauma, clinical conditions, and crisis. A clear decision matrix for choosing the right tool.
- [What AI Reflection Scoring Should Actually Measure](https://aureliusagent.com/guides/ai-reflection-scoring/): AI reflection scoring should measure intention-action alignment, emotional granularity, pattern recognition over time, and behavioral follow-through: not word count or mood.
- [Aurelius Agent vs Rosebud: Accountability vs Empathy in AI Journaling](https://aureliusagent.com/guides/aurelius-vs-rosebud/): Rosebud is an empathetic AI journal that asks dig-deeper questions. Aurelius Agent is a Stoic accountability partner that audits the gap between intentions and actions. The choice depends on whether you need warmer questions or harder ones.
- [Aurelius Agent vs StoicMentor: Which AI Stoic Mentor Fits You?](https://aureliusagent.com/guides/aurelius-vs-stoicmentor/): Aurelius Agent is a Stoic accountability partner that audits intentions against actions. StoicMentor is an AI Marcus Aurelius character offering coaching dialogue. Different mechanisms for different users.
- [Can AI Keep You Accountable? What the Evidence Says](https://aureliusagent.com/guides/can-ai-keep-you-accountable/): AI accountability works when it combines consistent daily presence, pattern recognition across weeks, and honest feedback. Here's the evidence for what works and what doesn't.
- [The Evening Review: Marcus Aurelius's Most Powerful Habit, Now With AI](https://aureliusagent.com/guides/evening-review-marcus-aurelius/): Marcus Aurelius and Seneca both practiced evening review, examining each day against their principles. AI adds pattern recognition, scoring, and honest feedback to this 2,000-year-old practice.
- [How to Journal Like Marcus Aurelius: With AI](https://aureliusagent.com/guides/journal-like-marcus-aurelius/): Marcus Aurelius practiced evening review and morning preparation daily. AI serves as the honest mirror he wrote for himself, reading back, scoring, and naming what you avoid seeing.
- [Morning Stoic Preparation + Evening Review: The Complete Framework](https://aureliusagent.com/guides/morning-evening-stoic-framework/): A complete daily Stoic framework: 5-minute morning preparation (premeditatio malorum, intention setting) plus 5-minute evening review (audit against principles). The two practices reinforce each other.
- [Philosophical Accountability vs Behavioral Enforcement: Why Most Apps Get This Wrong](https://aureliusagent.com/guides/philosophical-accountability/): Behavioral enforcement (streaks, penalties, rewards) treats symptoms. Philosophical accountability examines the gap between who you say you are and what you actually do, and that distinction changes everything.
- [Best Stoic Journal Prompts: And Why Static Prompts Miss the Point](https://aureliusagent.com/guides/stoic-journal-prompts/): Morning, evening, and weekly Stoic journal prompts based on Marcus Aurelius, Seneca, and Epictetus. Static prompts get you started. AI-generated prompts that respond to your patterns keep you growing.
- [Stoic Journaling App: What It Should Actually Do](https://aureliusagent.com/guides/stoic-journaling-app/): A genuine Stoic journaling app should implement prosoche (attention), evening audit, and premeditatio malorum, not just display Marcus Aurelius quotes over a CBT mood tracker.
